dedupe_keys.name: eia 860m preliminary monthly electric generator inventory operating proposed and retired us generators 1 mw and above monthly since 2015

description: The Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory is EIA's monthly update of the US generator fleet, based on Form EIA-860M as a supplement to the annual Form EIA-860. Contents: unit-level status of existing and proposed generating units at electric power plants with 1 MW or more of combined nameplate capacity, with a Retired tab listing generators retired since 2002 (from March 2017 data) and Puerto Rico units included from March 2018 data; EIA integrates survey responses with its own research on new units, and the early release covers roughly 20,000 operating and proposed generators. Producer: EIA. Coverage: United States and Puerto Rico; monthly files from 2015 to the release of 24 September 2026, with the next release dated 23 October 2026. Format and access: one Excel workbook per month on the EIA-860M page. Licence: public domain; EIA's copyright and reuse page says U.S. government publications are not subject to copyright and asks users to acknowledge the source with its publication date. Caveats: capacities are preliminary estimates that EIA corrects in later months without notice, some data are used before full verification, and they are not capacity commitments; the final inventory is the annual EIA-860. Simulation uses: current and planned generation fleet for capacity expansion and adequacy models, tracking retirements and pipeline projects between annual releases. Related records: data-eia-860-annual-electric-generator-report, data-eia-923-power-plant-operations and data-eia-us-energy-atlas-and-maps.
